svg.text: Fleet DR in VCF 9.1: two instances, one stretched management segment
What is replicated, what is redeployed, and what never leaves its site — when Site A and Site B are too far apart for a stretched cluster
NSX Location A · Global Manager active · all fleet components run here
NSX Location B · Global Manager standby · placeholders until failover
RTEP Geneve tunnels · Federation data plane
seg-vcf-mgmt · one overlay segment stretched by Federation · same subnet and gateway in both locations
VM management VLAN A · not stretched · reaches the segment through Tier-0 A
VM management VLAN B · not stretched · reaches the segment through Tier-0 B
same server, or replicated A → B
